# C4 beta diagram syntax

<!-- Generated by tools/gen-grammar from packages/diagram-c4/grammar/c4beta.ebnf. Do not edit: run `pnpm gen:grammar`. -->

C4 beta syntax (R-PARSE-9, spec #730): the normative grammar of `c4-beta` diagrams.

The hand-written parser in `src/beta/` implements it; `tools/gen-grammar` builds a reference
parser, a sentence generator, highlighters and the syntax reference page from it. There is no
v12 release to follow (`c4-beta` is in open v12 pull requests only), so this file and spec #730
decide the syntax, and the parser must match this file (DESIGN §4.4). Where the v12 prototype
differs, the spec lists why.

**Lexer input.** The lexer reads the diagram body: front matter removed, `%%{…}%%` directives
blanked out. Before the header, any whitespace regex `\s` matches is a blank (a byte-order mark,
a no-break space), as the detector reads it; after it, only tabs and spaces. A statement ends at a line break; `%%` starts a comment outside strings. Words are
case-sensitive. An id is words of letters, digits and `_` joined by single `-`, so `a-->b`
reads as `a`, `-->`, `b`. Only `title`, `accTitle`, `accDescr`, `direction`, `legend` and
`style` are reserved: every other word, element kinds included, may be an id. A step (`2:`) is
digits and a colon at the start of a line.

A statement stands on one line; an element's body is its `{` at the end of its line, element
lines, and a `}` on a line of its own.

## Grammar

EBNF: `[ x ]` is optional, `{ x }` repeats zero or more times, `x+` one or more times, `|` separates alternatives. Upper-case names and `subgraph`, `end`, `acc_…`, `direction_…` are tokens (see below). A rule marked `@Type` builds an AST node of that type.

A diagram is `c4-beta`, an optional kind, then statements, one per line.

```ebnf
c4beta = { NEWLINE } Header { NEWLINE [ statement ] } EOF ;
```

`c4-beta container`: the header and the kind, `context` when it is left out.

```ebnf
Header @Header = HEADER [ kind ] ;
```

```ebnf
kind = CONTEXT
     | CONTAINER
     | COMPONENT
     | DYNAMIC
     | DEPLOYMENT ;
```

```ebnf
statement = Title
          | AccTitle
          | AccDescr
          | Direction
          | Legend
          | Style
          | Element
          | Relation ;
```

`title Payments`: the title drawn above the diagram (the last one wins).

```ebnf
Title @Title = TITLE ;
```

`accTitle: Payments view`: the accessible title.

```ebnf
AccTitle @AccTitle = ACC_TITLE ;
```

`accDescr: …` or `accDescr { … }`: the accessible description.

```ebnf
AccDescr @AccDescr = ACC_DESCR ;
```

`direction LR`: the layout direction, at the top level only.

```ebnf
Direction @Direction = DIRECTION ( TB | BT | LR | RL ) ;
```

`legend off`: shows or hides the legend.

```ebnf
Legend @Legend = LEGEND ( ON | OFF ) ;
```

`style store shape:cylinder, fill:#1f2937`: the target is a tag or an element kind.

```ebnf
Style @Style = STYLE id entry { COMMA entry } ;
```

```ebnf
entry = id COLON ( HEX | id ) ;
```

`container api "API" "Serves orders." "Kotlin" :::team`: an element with a name, a
description and a technology, `instances` for a deployment node, tags, and a body of elements
in braces.

```ebnf
Element @Element = elemKind id STRING [ STRING [ STRING ] ] [ INSTANCES STRING ] { TAG } [ body ] ;
```

```ebnf
elemKind = PERSON
         | SOFTWARE_SYSTEM
         | CONTAINER
         | COMPONENT
         | GROUP
         | DEPLOYMENT_NODE
         | INFRASTRUCTURE_NODE ;
```

```ebnf
body = LBRACE ( RBRACE | NEWLINE { NEWLINE | Element NEWLINE } RBRACE ) ;
```

`2: api --> db : "Reads" "SQL" :::async`: a relation, its step (dynamic diagrams), its
description and technology, and tags.

```ebnf
Relation @Relation = [ STEP COLON ] id arrow id [ COLON STRING [ STRING ] ] { TAG } ;
```

```ebnf
arrow = ARROW_RIGHT
      | ARROW_LEFT
      | ARROW_BOTH
      | ARROW_UNDIRECTED ;
```

Any word but the six reserved ones.

```ebnf
id = ID
   | HEADER
   | CONTEXT
   | CONTAINER
   | COMPONENT
   | DYNAMIC
   | DEPLOYMENT
   | PERSON
   | SOFTWARE_SYSTEM
   | GROUP
   | DEPLOYMENT_NODE
   | INFRASTRUCTURE_NODE
   | INSTANCES
   | ON
   | OFF
   | TB
   | BT
   | LR
   | RL ;
```

## Tokens

The lexer works in modes (`INITIAL` and the ones below). In each mode it tries the rules in this order and takes the first that matches; a rule may push a mode or pop back to the previous one. Rules without a token emit nothing.

Modes: `INITIAL`.

| Modes | Token | Pattern | Action | Doc |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| INITIAL | HEADER | `c4-beta(?!\w\|-\w)` |  | `c4-beta`: starts a c4-beta diagram. An id of the same spelling is read as the header too, and is allowed as an id. |
| INITIAL | CONTEXT | `context(?!\w\|-\w)` |  | `context`: the diagram kind, system context. The default. |
| INITIAL | CONTAINER | `container(?!\w\|-\w)` |  | `container`: a diagram kind after `c4-beta`, and the element kind of a container. |
| INITIAL | COMPONENT | `component(?!\w\|-\w)` |  | `component`: a diagram kind after `c4-beta`, and the element kind of a component. |
| INITIAL | DYNAMIC | `dynamic(?!\w\|-\w)` |  | `dynamic`: the diagram kind whose relations carry a step number, `2: a --> b`. |
| INITIAL | DEPLOYMENT | `deployment(?!\w\|-\w)` |  | `deployment`: the diagram kind of deployment nodes and infrastructure nodes. |
| INITIAL | PERSON | `person(?!\w\|-\w)` |  | `person`: an element for a user of the system. |
| INITIAL | SOFTWARE_SYSTEM | `softwareSystem(?!\w\|-\w)` |  | `softwareSystem`: an element for a software system. |
| INITIAL | GROUP | `group(?!\w\|-\w)` |  | `group`: a frame around elements, with no meaning of its own. |
| INITIAL | DEPLOYMENT_NODE | `deploymentNode(?!\w\|-\w)` |  | `deploymentNode`: a node of a deployment, with a technology and a number of instances. |
| INITIAL | INFRASTRUCTURE_NODE | `infrastructureNode(?!\w\|-\w)` |  | `infrastructureNode`: infrastructure such as a load balancer, inside a deployment node. |
| INITIAL | INSTANCES | `instances(?!\w\|-\w)` |  | `instances "2..4"`: how many instances of a deployment node run. |
| INITIAL | ON | `on(?!\w\|-\w)` |  | `on`: `legend on` shows the legend. |
| INITIAL | OFF | `off(?!\w\|-\w)` |  | `off`: `legend off` hides the legend. |
| INITIAL | TB | `TB(?!\w\|-\w)` |  | `TB`: top to bottom, the default direction. |
| INITIAL | BT | `BT(?!\w\|-\w)` |  | `BT`: bottom to top. |
| INITIAL | LR | `LR(?!\w\|-\w)` |  | `LR`: left to right. |
| INITIAL | RL | `RL(?!\w\|-\w)` |  | `RL`: right to left. |
| INITIAL | DIRECTION | `direction(?!\w\|-\w)` |  | `direction LR`: the direction of the layout, once, at the top level. |
| INITIAL | LEGEND | `legend(?!\w\|-\w)` |  | `legend off`: shows or hides the legend. |
| INITIAL | STYLE | `style(?!\w\|-\w)` |  | `style store shape:cylinder, fill:#1f2937`: how elements of a tag or a kind are drawn. |
| INITIAL | TITLE | `title(?!\w\|-\w)[^\n\r]*?(?=%%\|[\r\n]\|$)` |  | `title <text>`: the diagram title, the rest of the line up to a `%%` comment. |
| INITIAL | ACC_TITLE | `accTitle(?!\w\|-\w)[\t ]*:[^\n\r]*?(?=%%\|[\r\n]\|$)` |  | `accTitle: <text>`: the accessible title, the rest of the line up to a `%%` comment. |
| INITIAL | ACC_DESCR | `accDescr(?!\w\|-\w)[\t ]*:[^\n\r]*?(?=%%\|[\r\n]\|$)` |  | `accDescr: <text>` (the rest of the line) or `accDescr { … }` (over lines, to `}`): the accessible description. |
| INITIAL | ACC_DESCR | `accDescr(?!\w\|-\w)\s*\{[\s\S]*?\}` |  |  |
| INITIAL | ARROW_RIGHT | `-->` |  | `-->`: a relation from the first element to the second. |
| INITIAL | ARROW_LEFT | `<--(?!>)` |  | `<--`: a relation read right to left: the second element is its source. |
| INITIAL | ARROW_BOTH | `<-->` |  | `<-->`: a relation that points both ways. |
| INITIAL | ARROW_UNDIRECTED | `---(?![->])` |  | `---`: a relation with no arrowhead, drawn between the two elements as it is written. `----` and `--->` are not undirected arrows. |
| INITIAL | TAG | `:::[A-Za-z0-9_]+(?:-[A-Za-z0-9_]+)*` |  | `:::team`: a tag on an element or a relation. |
| INITIAL | COLON | `:` |  |  |
| INITIAL | COMMA | `,` |  |  |
| INITIAL | LBRACE | `\{` |  |  |
| INITIAL | RBRACE | `\}` |  |  |
| INITIAL | STEP | `(?<=(?:^\|[\n\r])[\t ]*)[0-9]+(?=[\t ]*:)` |  | `2:`: the step of a relation in a dynamic diagram: digits and a colon, at the start of a line. The colon is a token of its own. |
| INITIAL | HEX | `#(?:[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}\|[0-9A-Fa-f]{3})(?!\w)` |  | `#1f2937`: a colour of a style, three or six hex digits. |
| INITIAL | STRING | `"(?:[^"\\\r\n]\|\\.)*"\|'(?:[^'\\\r\n]\|\\.)*'` |  | `"Ledger"` or `'Ledger'`: text. `\` escapes the next character. A string ends on its line. |
| INITIAL | ID | `(?!(?:accTitle\|accDescr)(?!\w\|-\w))[A-Za-z0-9_]+(?:-[A-Za-z0-9_]+)*` |  | An id: words of letters, digits and `_` joined by single `-`. The reserved words `title`, `accTitle`, `accDescr`, `direction`, `legend` and `style` are not ids. |
| INITIAL | NEWLINE | `\r\n\|\n\|\r` |  |  |
| INITIAL | — | `[\t ]+` |  |  |
| INITIAL | COMMENT | `%%[^\n\r]*` |  | `%%` to the end of the line: a comment. |
| INITIAL | EOF | `$` |  | The end of the text. |

Removed before lexing (highlighted only):

- DIRECTIVE: `[^\S\n]*%%\{[\s\S]*?\}%%`
